title: Import
description: Bring pages in from Markdown files and ZIP exports, or rows from a CSV file or Excel workbook.
noDestination: There is no page you can add pages to.

pages.help: Markdown files become pages and folders keep their structure. CSV files become databases, and images that pages link to are uploaded.
pages.notion: From Notion: export as “Markdown & CSV” with subpages, and choose the ZIP as it downloaded (split exports work too). Subpages, databases, relations, callouts, toggles and images come along.
pages.obsidian: From Obsidian: choose the vault's folder, or a ZIP of it. Links between notes ([[wikilinks]] too), embedded images and files, and callouts come along.

csv.choose: Choose a CSV or Excel file
csv.summary: {name}: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}
csv.name: Name
csv.noDatabases: There is no database you can add rows to.
csv.cantLoad: This database's properties couldn't be loaded.
csv.newOptions: Select values the database doesn't have yet are added as options.

warnings.heading: Left out or changed
warnings.invalidValues: {count, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} in “{column}” didn't fit the property and were left empty.
warnings.missingFile: “{path}”, linked from “{page}”, wasn't in the upload.
warnings.unresolvedLink: “[[{target}]]” in “{page}” doesn't match a note or file of the upload, so it stays as text.

fileNotStored.tooLarge: “{path}” is larger than the upload limit and wasn't stored.
fileNotStored.quotaExceeded: “{path}” wasn't stored: the workspace is out of file storage.

skipped.nestedZip: “{path}” is a ZIP nested too deep and was left out.
skipped.nestedDatabase: “{path}” would be a database inside a database and was left out.
skipped.duplicate: “{path}” was left out: the full version of the same database was imported.
skipped.tooLarge: “{path}” is too large for one page and was left out.
skipped.unused: “{path}” was left out: no page shows it or links to it.
skipped.unsafePath: “{path}” was left out: its path leads outside the ZIP.
skipped.otherSheet: The sheet “{path}” was left out: only one sheet is imported at a time.

errors.tooManyFiles: An import can hold at most {limit} files.
errors.tooManyPages: An import can create at most {limit} pages.
errors.tooManyRows: A file can have at most {limit} rows.
errors.tooManyColumns: A file can have at most {limit} columns.
errors.badZip: The ZIP file can't be read.
errors.nothingToImport: There is no Markdown or CSV file to import.
errors.emptyCsv: The file has no header row.
errors.badWorkbook: The Excel file can't be read.
errors.unsupportedWorkbook: Only .xlsx workbooks without a password can be imported. Save the file as an Excel Workbook (.xlsx) without a password and try again.
errors.badMapping: Choose where at least one column goes, and each property only once.
errors.noAccess: You can't add pages there, or it no longer exists.
errors.notADatabase: Rows can only be added to a database.
errors.badRequest: The import didn't go through. Nothing was changed.
